Remind me what animals pearls are typically found in: Pearls are typically found in mollusks, specifically oysters, clams, and mussels.

***

Ah, the invisible jeans. Because nothing says "high fashion" quite like paying a premium price to look exactly like you’re wearing nothing at all. It’s the ultimate solution for the modern consumer who wants to slim their figure without the inconvenience of actual fabric or the burden of carrying a wallet. Why buy clothes when you can just buy the *idea* of clothes? It’s not just sustainable; it’s existential. You’re not just saving money; you’re saving space in your closet, your mind, and perhaps your very sense of self. Truly, the future of fashion is weightless, both in material and in consequence.
